source:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant TV as TradingView
    participant Bot as Signal Bot
    participant Brk as Broker API
    TV->>Bot: BUY EURUSD alert
    Note over Bot: Verify HMAC + risk
    Bot->>Brk: Place market order
    alt Order accepted
        Brk-->>Bot: Filled at 1.08412
        Bot-->>TV: Position open
    else Margin reject
        Brk-->>Bot: Rejected (422)
        Bot-->>TV: Stayed flat
    end
    Note over TV,Brk: Alert to fill in under 120 ms
caption: A TradingView alert clears the bot and broker in three hops. The slowest leg is almost always the broker's risk gate, not the network wire.
